Talent mismatch occurs when a candidate ideally suited for an organization does not deliver what the employer expected.
Talent mismatch is an opportunity cost that significantly impacts productivity.
LinkedIn quantified the loss in productivity due to talent mismatch at $130 billion.
The research found a strong correlation between the adaptability of talent in a country and the performance of its companies.
